subject: Issues with model fit for Dail-Madsen n mixture model

messages.author: d2e30bb3446a218e
messages.subject: Issues with model fit for Dail-Madsen n mixture model
parts:
Hi there,

I posted in another thread regarding the goodness-of-fit test for the Gompertz dynamics type, but that's since been resolved - however, I'm running into a different kind of difficulty, and am a little lost on how to proceed - would love to get your thoughts on this. Essentially, my best performing model (using AIC) does not perform well in the goodness of fit test. In fact, the null model seems to have a better result even though when I compare AIC, it is much higher. I've tried adding and removing covariates, changing the dynamics type as well as the mixture type, but the results do not improve. Not sure what else I can do to improve the fit of my model. The following is what I did: 

I'm running an open population N-mixture model with unmarked. I have a total of 29 sites, 4 primary survey periods and 4 secondary survey periods. 
Tabulation of y observations:

+                      dynamics="gompertz",
+                      mixture='NB', K=100)
